content: Ina tuɣa d arrawen n Dawud inni d as dd-ittwarwen di Ḥabrun: amenzu tuɣa d Amnun n Axinuɛam, Tayazraɛilit; wiss tnayen Daniyal n Abijayil, Takarmalit;
wiss třata Abcalum, mmis n Maɛka, yeǧis n Talmay, ajeǧid n Jacur; wiss arebɛa Aduniya, mmis n Hajjit;
wiss xemsa Cafaṭya n Abiṭal, wiss setta Yitarɛam, n temɣart nnes Ɛajla.
Ttwarwen as-dd setta di Ḥabrun, minzi iḥkem dinni sebɛa n iseggʷusa d setta n iyuren u di Urcalim iḥkem třata u-třatin n iseggʷusa.
Ina ttwarwen as-dd di Urcalim: Cimɛa, Cubab, Natan, Suliman. Arebɛa-ya tuɣa aten d arrawen n Bat-Cuɛ, yeǧis n Ɛammiyil.
Xenni Yibḥar, Ilicamɛa, Ilifalaṭ,
Nujah, Nafaj, Yafiɛ,
Ilicamaɛ, Iliyadaɛ, Ilifalaṭ, tesɛa n warrawen.
Ina marra d arrawen n Dawud, nhřa arrawen n tiyya, u Tamar tuɣa d učmatsen.
Mmis n Suliman tuɣa-t d Raḥabɛam, mmis Abiya, mmis Asa, mmis Yahucafaṭ,
mmis Yahuram, mmis Axazya, mmis Yuwac,
mmis Amaṣya, mmis Ɛazarya, mmis Yutam,
mmis Aḥaz, mmis Ḥizqiya, mmis Manassa,
mmis Amun d mmis Yuciya.
Arrawen n Yuciya tuɣa aten d amenzu Yuḥanan, wiss tnayen Yahuyaqim, wiss třata Ṣidqiya, wiss arebɛa Callum.
Arrawen n Yahuyaqim: mmis Yakunya d mmis Ṣidqiya.
Arrawen n Yakunya: Assir, Caɛaltiyil tuɣa d mmis,
u xenni Malkiram d Fadaya d Cinaṣṣar d Yaqamya d Hucamɛa d Nadabya.
Arrawen n Fadaya tuɣa aten d Zarubbabil d Cimɛi. Arrawen n Zarubbabil tuɣa aten d Macullam d Ḥananya, u učmatsen tuɣa-tt d Calumit,
u xenni Ḥacuba d Uwhil d Baraxya d Ḥasadya d Yucab-Ḥasad, xemsa n warrawen.
Arrawen n Ḥanan-Yah tuɣa aten Falaṭ-Yah, d Icaɛya. Arrawen n Rafaya, arrawen n Arnan, arrawen n Ɛubadya, arrawen n Cakanya.
Arrawen n Caxanya, mɣir Camɛiya. Arrawen n Cimɛiya tuɣa aten d Ḥattuc, Yijɛal, Bariḥ, Naɛarya d Cafat, setta n warrawen.
Arrawen n Naɛarya tuɣa aten d Ilyuɛinay, Ḥizqiya d Ɛazriqam, třata n warrawen.
Arrawen n Ilyuɛinay tuɣa aten d Hudawyahu, Ilyacib, Falaya, Ɛaqqub, Yuḥanan, Dalaya d Ɛanani, sebɛa n warrawen.

footnotes.text: Tayazraɛilit- ict n temɣart zi Yazraɛil. Takarmalit- ict n temɣart zi Karmil.
Bat-Cuɛ- isem-a wanita urin t ‘Batcabaɛ’ mani nneɣni.
